meta.name: m1d1-ten-case-judge-application
revision_notes: P0：执行载体改为 rag_judge_service.judge_trace 的 production Service replay；不再直接调 RagJudgeAgent
P0：构造 synthetic RagTrace（adapter=fixture、mode=query、context_source=agent_chat、status=success），driver 只汇总 JudgeOutcome
P1-1：方法 A Judge-only 固定 pilot answer/contexts/gold；不做端到端 query Run
P1-2：Q36 C 同时报 base/variant，只作诊断，不参与 PASS/FAIL
P1-3：Q23/Q35/Q36 固定 3 次，触发/合成规则预注册
P1-4：补充可复算 token/成本表、单价来源、51 次上限（48 planned + 3 reserve）与 ceiling 硬停止

run_config.execution_vehicle: production Service replay: rag_judge_service.judge_trace(session=None, trace=synthetic RagTrace, item=synthetic item, prompt_version='v1.2.0'); driver only aggregates JudgeOutcome; no reimplementation of F scoring

synthetic_trace.note: context_source=agent_chat is required by _skip_reason for F; no RAG adapter call; no RagEvaluationRun

fixture.note: fixed v1.1.5 10-case gate answer/contexts/gold; no WeKnora, no retrieval, no new answer generation; fixture target field is historical, v1.0.2 target is authoritative

run_config.llm_endpoint: existing DashScope-compatible endpoint used by prior qwen-max gates; no key in repo
run_config.credential_scope: existing runtime LLM credential (BYOK or server-key fallback); preflight must verify; no key in repo
run_config.env_scope: process-local for this Judge-only replay only; do not write to repo/.env; restore after replay
run_config.top_k_note: not applicable: contexts are fixed fixture inputs; no retrieval/adapter call

cases.baseline_reference: old run only; not v1.2.0 measured
old run only; not v1.2.0 measured

q36_c_policy.pass_fail: C not used for 10-case PASS/FAIL; report base and variant; F/R still use targets

repeat_policy.trigger: always scheduled; no first-run condition; no discretionary decision
repeat_policy.decision_owner: pre-registered by this application; no post-hoc choice

synthesis.Q23: PASS only if 3/3 in target and no invalid/HG quote violation
synthesis.Q35: PASS if >=2/3 in target and no invalid/HG quote violation
synthesis.Q36: PASS if >=2/3 in target for F/R and no invalid/HG quote violation; C diagnostic only

repeat_policy.report: all 3 runs; median/min/max; no best-only reporting

token_estimate.method: conservative per-metric estimate: prompt tokens + fixed fixture payload tokens + output tokens; Chinese text ~1 token per character; actual usage from LLMUsage is authoritative

pricing.source: qwen-max public price used by prior project docs (pilot-10-v1.0.0-vs-v1.1.1.md; pilot-10-v1.1.2-gate-final2.md); actual DashScope bill is authoritative

budget.hard_stop: After each case, read actual usage; if cumulative or projected cost exceeds CNY 1.00, or calls exceed 51, stop immediately; no further calls
budget.note: 51 calls = 16 planned case-runs (10 primary + 6 HG repeats) + 1 execution-retry reserve case-run; no 40-case spend; not repeated prompt tuning

stop_conditions.condition: fixture SHA、10 个 case/answer/contexts/gold、LLM endpoint/model/credential、Prompt/MANIFEST SHA 或 22/22 validation 任一不满足
stop_conditions.action: 拒绝启动 Judge-only replay；不得跳过 preflight

stop_conditions.condition: 任一 case/metric 出现 invalid(contract_violation)，包括 schema/subtype/evidence/quote/conflict 违约
stop_conditions.action: 立即停止；保留已完成结果；不得改 Prompt 或放宽契约后重跑

stop_conditions.condition: 任一 case/metric 出现 failed(execution)
stop_conditions.action: 同配置最多重试一次；再次失败立即停止

stop_conditions.condition: Q23/Q35/Q36 任一 supported claim 的 quote 非逐字、跨片段拼接或引用 answer
stop_conditions.action: 立即停止；不得把 HG quote invalid 当 known diagnostic 放行

stop_conditions.condition: Q29 的 F 不是 skipped(no_scorable_claims)
stop_conditions.action: 立即停止；不得用 0.0 或其它 skipped 兜底

stop_conditions.condition: 有 baseline 的 case 出现 old - new > 0.10 + 1e-9 的未解释下降
stop_conditions.action: 停止并人工复核；恰好 0.10 不停止

stop_conditions.condition: 第二次出现 evidence typo、数字/日期/金额改动
10 个 case 未全部产出 3 个指标结果，或任一 case 缺 F/C/R
stop_conditions.action: 停止；不得把缺失 case 当 skipped

stop_conditions.condition: 累计或预估成本超过 CNY 1.00，或 Judge 调用超过 51 次
stop_conditions.action: 立即停止；不得追加调用

stop_conditions.condition: prompt SHA / MANIFEST SHA / fixture SHA / schema / metric / model / temperature / max_tokens 与申请不一致
stop_conditions.action: 拒绝启动或立即停止；不得静默换版本

stop_conditions.condition: v1.2.0 被设为默认、active=true 或 runtime_active=true
stop_conditions.action: 立即停止；回到 frozen / active=false

failure_handling.invalid: 不重试；保留 invalid_reason 与 validation_errors；停止并复审
failure_handling.failed_execution: 同配置最多重试一次；不得改 Prompt/Schema/model
failure_handling.skipped: 按 case 语义单独记录；不得把 skipped 当 PASS
failure_handling.budget: 达到 CNY 1.00 或 51 次调用即停止；不得追加预算
failure_handling.stop: 保留已完成结果与配置快照；不启动 40；重新申请后才可继续
failure_handling.no_prompt_tuning: 10 条期间不得改 Prompt、Schema、Service、目标或 stop conditions

report_requirements: 逐条写 PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED；Q29 只能按 skipped 语义判定
HG 3 条（Q23/Q35/Q36）与 provisional 7 条分开，不混算均值
Q17 标 policy_relationship_target_reapproval；Q35/Q36 标 old run only，不冒充端到端新答案
报告写 fixture SHA、target v1.0.2 SHA、final_labels SHA、Prompt SHA、MANIFEST SHA、schema/metric version
报告写 model/temperature/max_tokens 与 Judge-only fixture 方法；不写 adapter/top_k 为实测值
Q23/Q35/Q36 报告 3 次全部结果、median/min/max，不报最好一次
Q36 的 C 同时报 base 0.5–0.6 与 variant 0.9–1.0，只作诊断，不参与 PASS/FAIL
结论只能写 implemented/verified/blocked；不得自行写 accepted
boundaries: 本文件是申请材料，不是 Judge 运行；未调用模型、未创建 Run
方法 A：Judge-only 固定 pilot answer/contexts/gold；不调用 WeKnora、不做检索、不生成新答案
adapter 与 top_k 不适用；不得把 Judge-only 结果解释为端到端 RAG 效果
不激活 v1.2.0；active 保持 false、runtime_active 保持 false
qwen-max / max_tokens 只作本次 Judge-only replay 的临时进程环境，不写入仓库或长期 .env
不运行 40 条；10 条通过后才可单独申请 40 条
不启动 M2/M3；不把 M1-C/M1-D 标 accepted
不把 Q17/Q32 的预期标签写成实测；本申请不含 Q32
approval_items: 确认方法 A：Judge-only 固定 pilot fixture，不使用端到端 query Run
确认 v1.2.0 frozen Prompt SHA、MANIFEST SHA、fixture SHA、schema v3、metric v3
确认 Judge 配置：qwen-max / temperature=0.0 / max_tokens=8192 / prompt v1.2.0
确认预算：主运行 30 次、最大 51 次（48 planned + 3 retry reserve）、ceiling CNY 1.00
确认 HG 重复规则与 Q36 C 双报诊断规则
确认停止条件与失败处理
确认不会激活 v1.2.0、不会改默认版本、不会跑 40
批准后才执行 10 条；执行后停下报告
